reviews.text: I love this local pet shop!  Every time we walk past with dogs and we're not going in, our dogs stop automatically because they love the staff there. On top of them bringing in my dogs 's special food due to diet restrictions they have a huge variety of everything. Highly recommend it and shop local.

Outstanding customer service at St. Clair Pets!  My cat only eats one flavor of one specific kind of food, just to be difficult, as cats can be.  The staff consistently go the extra mile to make sure he stays fed.   Slam dunk, five stars.

We absolutely love shopping at St. Clair Pets!
The staff are wonderful, but we especially love Emma and Daniel! 🩷

Emma is honestly one of the biggest reasons why we continued coming back to St. Clair Pets from the beginning. When I first found out about all of my dog’s allergies, I was incredibly stressed and overwhelmed trying to figure out what he could safely eat. Emma was SO kind, patient, and genuinely caring throughout the whole process. They took the time to research different food options, answer all my questions, and make sure we found something that would work for him. They truly went above and beyond, and it meant more to us than they probably realize!

Daniel is also absolutely wonderful! He’s always so sweet with our dog and showers him with so much love whenever we visit. He’s incredibly knowledgeable and has consistently given us great recommendations and advice.

It’s so rare to find people who genuinely care about your pets as much as you do. You can tell that they truly care about the animals and the people who love them.

I’ve been coming to this pet store in Toronto for a while now, and it never disappoints. The place is always clean and well-organized, which makes shopping a real pleasure. What really stands out, though, is the staff — they’re consistently friendly, patient, and genuinely helpful. Whether I’m picking up everyday supplies or looking for advice, they take the time to help without ever making it feel rushed. It’s become my go-to spot, and I highly recommend it to any pet owner.
I’ve had consistently great experiences with everyone who works here. So friendly and helpful!

An amazing store with many great products and wonderful staff! Thank you to Daniel who was very accommodating, knowledgeable, and kind when helping me with my purchase, will be making this business my main pet store from now on!
Amazing store and staff ,always  a smile and free samples
Really cute and unique products and such nice staff!
Convenient but pricey.

Fantastic pet shop with a good assortment of food brands, treats, and toys. My dogs absolutely love stopping in when our walks take us by the shop.

I have always had an excellent experience when in the store. The folks working here have been helpful with finding what I need. When I haven’t had a specific brand in mind they've given great recommendations for options they have in the store.
Best all stop shop for all pet supplies. Highly recommend

Lucy and Kayla were amazing! They helped me get off of my Vet Food. They showed me this cool new brand SquarePet! Vet formulated, can tell me where everything comes from in the bag and full technical data sheets to compare! Thank you for saving me $$$$
Wonderful owner and staff
Lots of Canadian made products, which is why we went there.
super kind staff and willing to bring in special treats for your little guys 🫶 …
The young lady working today (March 27 @ 3:00pm) had great energy and was very helpful. :)
Friendly and knowledgeable staff, and a fantastic selection of products. This is our go-to shop for our spoiled kitties.
Truly a gem. They have the best product selection with the highest quality. The business owner truly cares about dogs. My dog loves this store and can’t keep his excitement when we stop by.

First time pet owner. Got to meet the owner and she always greets everyone with a smile. I was unsure of the things I needed but the owner helped me out and picked out a few things which a new pet owner would need. Also gave out a few treats.

Thank you St. Clair Pets, I will definitely be coming back.
Great store, very helpful
Great spot! Really nice people, lots of selection, and they even order in special requests when possible. Plus they always give free samples!
Amazing customer service. Also, gave a free sample. Come here whenever you need something for your loved one!
Thank you 🐶😺 …

Fantastic local place that has a great selection of items. Their staff are super friendly and always offer samples to bring home, which is so sweet. They also often have new kinds of cat toys, so I love regularly visiting to get new toys for my cat.
Lots of variety of foods for my cats that I cannot find anywhere else. Great selection 👍🏽 …
Very knowledgeable staff and super friendly!
